intent.proves: At least one email uses the Abandoned cart recipients provider.

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs one call per subject (iterate ids from the list tool) and a client-side predicate. Predicate: providerTypeName ends with AbandonedCartRecipientProvider.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EmailMarketingEmail e LEFT JOIN EmailMarketingTopFolder tf ON tf.TopFolderId = e.EmailTopFolderId WHERE ISNULL(e.EmailIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND (CAST(e.EmailRecipientProviderConfiguration AS nvarchar(max)) LIKE N'%AbandonedCartRecipientProvider%' OR CAST(tf.TopFolderRecipientProviderConfiguration AS nvarchar(max)) LIKE N'%AbandonedCartRecipientProvider%')
bindings.reason: Recipient provider configuration is an AddIn parameter blob (GetParametersToXml); that it carries the provider type name as text is assumed from the ScheduledTask settings format, not verified on 10.29.8.

sources.ref: nuget Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8 (table and column names in assembly SQL strings)
